title: identity
description: Who the agent is: the names it answers to, what it is, and how it introduces itself. One document per workspace, written by the host and read by the runtime before every turn.

names.description: Every name the agent answers to, in any language or spelling. The first is the one it introduces itself with.

handle.description: The machine handle people mention the agent by, on a messenger that has handles.

role.description: One line on what the agent is for at this company.

creature.description: What the agent is, when it has a form: a mascot, an animal, a character.

emoji.description: The emoji that stands for the agent.

introduction.description: How the agent introduces itself when asked who it is.
